output.evaluation_note: The Part of Speech (POS) is incorrectly listed as 'verb' for all three languages. 'Capacity' (English), '体積' (Japanese), and 'thể tích' (Vietnamese) are all nouns when referring to the concept of 'volume' or 'the maximum amount something can contain'. The provided English definition 'capacity, volume' clearly refers to the noun sense. This fundamental grammatical error makes the entire concept representation invalid and misleading for learners.
